title: Thodari
desc: Love blossoms between a pantry boy and a makeup artist aboard a train bound for Chennai. However, their journey becomes dangerous when the train is hijacked.

title: Sami Potta Mudichu
desc: Kadhirvelan wishes to take revenge on his uncle, who is responsible for his grandfather's death. However, he changes his mind after he meets Neelaveni, his uncle's daughter.

title: Vaimaye Vellum
desc: Raja, a rickshaw driver, shares a complicated relationship with his father. Things take a turn when a journalist investigating an ongoing crime hires him to protect his daughter.

title: Sakkarai Devan
desc: A young jaggery merchant invites the ire of a prominent man after he unites the people against his corruption. Things get worse when he falls in love with a woman.
